Our Story & Values

About ANT Human Services

Headquartered in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, ANT Human Services is a premier recruitment, staffing, and manpower solutions organization. We exist to empower businesses with workforce capacity and transform individual careers.

Rooted in Varanasi, UP

Beyond a "Job Consultancy": A Strategic Workforce Partner

Many agencies operate purely as transactional job brokers. ANT Human Services was founded to redefine recruitment in regional and national markets.

We sell to both sides of the market: helping business clients solve complex labor bottlenecks and helping job seekers unlock dignified, growth-oriented employment opportunities.

Our Central Philosophy:

People
Employment

Foundational Guiding Principles

The Pillars of ANT Human Services

Strategic Precision

We rigorously match candidates based on verified skills, experience, and organizational cultural fit.

100% Statutory Compliance

Full adherence to labor laws, EPF, ESI, and payroll governance for complete employer peace of mind.

Candidate Empathy

Strict adherence to ethical recruitment standards—zero candidate registration fees and genuine career growth guidance.

Scalable Execution

Capability to handle single specialized white-collar placements or mass 500+ contract labor drives seamlessly.

Varanasi Head Office & Maharashtra Branch Network

With key strategic centers in Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) and Badlapur, Thane (Maharashtra), ANT Human Services seamlessly bridges talent pools across North, West, and Central India, supplying skilled manpower to manufacturing hubs, logistics corridors, corporate offices, and service sectors.
